# YOLACT (RegNetX-1.6GF)

Instance Segmentation · `yolact_regnet-x1.6gf_512x512` · DX-APP Python example

Instance Segmentation model, evaluated on COCO.

**Input** 512 × 512 × 3 · **Dataset** COCO · **License** MIT · **Quantization** Q-Lite, Q-Pro

![YOLACT (RegNetX-1.6GF) output](result.webp)

Full card with copy buttons and dark/light theme (open it in a browser; GitHub shows its source): [model.html](model.html)

## Quick start

Run from the dx_app root after `./install.sh` and `./build.sh`.

```bash
# from the dx_app root
./setup_sample_models.sh --models yolact_regnetx_1.6gf
```

**Python**

```bash
python src/python_example/instance_segmentation/yolact/yolact_regnet-x1.6gf_512x512/yolact_regnet-x1.6gf_512x512_sync.py \
  --model assets/models/yolact_regnet-x1.6gf_512x512.dxnn \
  --image sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

**C++**

```bash
./build.sh --target yolact_regnet-x1.6gf_512x512_sync   # once
./bin/yolact_regnet-x1.6gf_512x512_sync \
  -m assets/models/yolact_regnet-x1.6gf_512x512.dxnn \
  -i sample/img/sample_street.jpg
```

## Accuracy

| Quantization | mAP |
|---|---:|
| Raw · ONNX | 19.42 |
| Q-Lite | 19.23 (−0.19) |
| Q-Pro | 19.40 (−0.02) |

COCO · difference vs Raw in brackets.
